articles.headline: India's October Trade Deficit Hits One-Year High
articles.brief: India's trade deficit widened to $39.88 billion in October, driven largely by a sharp surge in gold imports, according to recent trade figures released by Reuters.

articles.headline: Delhi Overtakes Lahore as World's Most Polluted City
articles.brief: Air quality levels in Delhi plummeted significantly, pushing the Indian capital past Lahore to become the most polluted major city globally as winter smog sets in.

articles.headline: Amazon Plans Product Data Domination to Counter AI Agents
articles.brief: E-commerce giant Amazon is reportedly rolling out aggressive strategies to consolidate global product data and counter emerging autonomous AI shopping assistants.

articles.headline: World Oil Market Returning to Surplus, Says IEA
articles.brief: The International Energy Agency reported that the global oil market is shifting back toward a surplus as production and exports from the Gulf region successfully recover.

articles.headline: SpaceX to Attempt First Land Starship Recovery
articles.brief: Aviation pioneer SpaceX announced plans to attempt its first-ever land-based recovery of a Starship spacecraft during the upcoming 15th integrated flight test.

articles.headline: Fintech Firm Razorpay Receives Regulatory Nod for IPO
articles.brief: Indian fintech major Razorpay has secured formal regulatory clearance to move forward with its initial public offering, expected to target around $600 million.

articles.headline: Tragic Minibus Collision Kills 23 Near Kaziranga Park
articles.brief: A high-speed collision between a minibus and a trailer truck on National Highway 715 near Assam's Kaziranga National Park left 23 people dead and several injured.

articles.headline: Manchester United Appoints Mauricio Pochettino as Manager
articles.brief: English Premier League club Manchester United has officially named Mauricio Pochettino as their new manager on a two-and-a-half-year contract running through 2029.

articles.headline: Jensen Huang Steps Down as Nvidia Chief Executive
articles.brief: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down from his position following a controversy involving a Chinese businesswoman linked to regional intelligence networks.

articles.headline: Bulk Scotch Whisky Imports Stalled at Indian Ports
articles.brief: Indian Commerce and Finance ministries held emergency discussions to resolve an ongoing dispute regarding customs duties on bulk Scotch whisky imports under the bilateral FTA.

articles.headline: Microsoft Struggles to Restore Services After Outage
articles.brief: Microsoft 365 services experienced extensive disruptions entering a second day, with enterprise users globally facing persistent email delivery delays and server timeouts.

articles.headline: Virat Kohli Equals Sachin Tendulkar's Unwanted ODI Record
articles.brief: Star Indian batsman Virat Kohli registered his 20th duck in One Day International cricket, tying Sachin Tendulkar for the most ducks by an Indian player.

articles.headline: Trump Signals Push for Iranian Regime Change
articles.brief: US President Donald Trump stated that the survival of Iran's ruling administration represents a failure of his foreign policy, urging citizens to challenge the regime.

articles.headline: India's Foreign Exchange Reserves Rise by $2.49 Billion
articles.brief: The Reserve Bank of India reported that the nation's total foreign exchange reserves increased to $719.55 billion during the week ending November 6.

articles.headline: NCP Merger Talks at Preliminary Stage, Says Bhujbal
articles.brief: Nationalist Congress Party leader Chhagan Bhujbal confirmed that discussions regarding a potential party merger are currently moving forward at a preliminary stage.
